cards.name: Sewerjaw Gator
cards.description: A mutated sewer alligator that ambushes prey in Seattle's underground drainage network.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.description: The Sewerjaw Gator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Death Roll
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a target the Gator has Restrained or otherwise pinned in its jaws. On a success, deal **2d8** physical damage and the target becomes Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Drain Surge
features.description: The Gator slips into water, sludge, or a drainage opening and reappears anywhere within Far range that is connected by sewer channels, culverts, runoff tunnels, or standing water.

features.name: Filth Spray
features.description: When the Gator takes Major damage, all creatures within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or mark a Stress as toxic sludge and sewer water spray across the area.

features.name: Cold Water Patience
features.description: While partially submerged or hidden in darkness, the Gator gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty until they attack or otherwise reveal their position.
